---
title: "My first weeks in MDS"
author: "Ethan Chen"
date: 2026-09-09
---

![Dinner with from friends on campus after imagine day.](orientation.jpg)

Orientation days were nerve-wracking, sitting long hours, trying to absorb all the information, and meeting professors and classmates for the first time. However, I ended up meeting a lot of new friends, many that come from similar and also different backgrounds.

First week of school was not too bad. It was a scramble to get to the classrooms and figure out breaks to eat, but in general it went pretty smoothly.

I am feeling ok, a little anxious for the workload and quizzes that are about to come, but also excited to enjoy campus life and work on some fun projects.
